issues.body: _instrumentation still accepts every non-None value without validating its JSON type or domain. Citation metrics consequently sum arbitrary values and can accept equal negative counts (for example emitted=-1 and resolved=-1 on every task yields fabricated=0 and honesty_ok=true), while abstention metrics use Python truthiness, so the string "false" is treated as an abstention. Malformed external answer records can therefore still produce honest=true and recommend_adopt=true. The tests cover missing instrumentation but not invalid values.
issues.fix_hint: Validate instrumentation before computing metrics: citations_emitted and citations_resolved must be non-boolean, non-negative integers, with resolved <= emitted for every record; abstained must be a JSON boolean. Add validation failures to blocked_reason so honest=false, and add end-to-end refusal tests for negative counts, resolved greater than emitted, boolean/float/string counts, and string/numeric abstained values.
issues.title: Instrumentation values remain unvalidated

verdict.summary: Round 5 is stagnant: the round-4 major finding remains unresolved. Required instrumentation is still checked only for presence, not for JSON type or valid domain, so malformed host records can fabricate passing honesty metrics. No malformed-value refusal tests were added.
